snippet.title: Squid Game for Game Boy (fully playable!)
snippet.description:
Yes, this is a real, playable Game Boy game - not just a trailer!

Play Squid Game: Game Boy Demake on real hardware, an emulator, or in your browser. It’s based entirely on Season 1 of the show, and just in time for Season 3!

🎮 Play it now on Newgrounds (in-browser):
https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/986666

📦 Download the full ROM, printable manual, box art, and cartridge sticker (free):
https://64bitsanimation.itch.io/squid-game-boy

This game includes:

6 playable games from Squid Game Season 1:
-Story Mode with cutscenes
-Minigame Select Mode
-A brutal Hard Mode with only one life
-3 endings, secrets, and cheat codes
-A full retro-style manual packed with extras
-Printable box art and cartridge sticker

Everything is free to download and not for sale - but if you want to tip us, Itch.io is pay-what-you-want (even $0).

Just looking for some cheats to finish the game, check this out ;) - (no need to be a Patreon): https://www.patreon.com/posts/squid-game-boy-132707662

Want to know how we made this? check out the making of over at @64bitsextra https://youtu.be/Wlo1s5uHleA

Or simply watch our own full playthrough, secret ending included: https://youtu.be/kmyhVMzj7Y8


This is a passion project from 64 Bits, known for animated game parodies - and this time, we made a real game! Built in GB Studio, fully playable on original Game Boy hardware, Analogue Pocket, or any emulator.

⚠️ This project is a fan-made tribute.
It is not affiliated with Netflix or the creators of Squid Game.

Hope you enjoy the trailer (and the game)!
Let us know what you think, and don’t forget to read the manual... some secrets are hidden in plain sight.
